>The Google links link to google-beta, which only links the thread
>not the exact article (hopefully they'll fix that), but there it
>is anyhow.

It's still possible to link to a single post through groups-beta, though.
Scroll to the post in the thread, click "Show options" and select "Show
original". If I do this for the first ruling I see on the Errata page, I
get:

http://groups-beta.google.com/group/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/msg/b176845a5229fc61?dmode=source

You can also select "View parsed" after that (or simply remove the
"?dmode=source" from the URL) and end up with an URL such as this one,
linking to the single post:

http://groups-beta.google.com/group/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/msg/b176845a5229fc61

--
charles lechasseur - da...@novideospamtron.ca
